title: DSP Utilities Module
summary: This module provides essential utilities for DSPy, including text tokenization, answer location within text, robust configuration management, and efficient loading of background data for retrieval tasks.

nodes.label: Tokenize Text
nodes.title: Simple Text Tokenizer
nodes.description: A basic tokenizer that splits text into alphanumeric and non-whitespace tokens, preparing it for further processing like answer location within a document.

nodes.label: Locate Answers in Text
nodes.title: Answer Occurrence Locator
nodes.description: Identifies and returns the character offsets of all occurrences of given tokenized answers within a larger text, leveraging tokenization for precise matching of answer spans.

nodes.label: Manage DSPy Configuration
nodes.title: DSPy Global Settings
nodes.description: Manages DSPy's global and thread-local configuration settings. It allows for setting default language models, adapters, and other parameters, with robust support for context-specific overrides and thread safety.

nodes.label: Load Query Backgrounds
nodes.title: Batch Background Loader
nodes.description: Retrieves and concatenates background passages for a batch of query IDs from a specified collection. This utility prepares contextual information, often used in retrieval-augmented generation tasks.

groups.label: Text Processing
groups.title: Text Processing Utilities
groups.description: Components for basic text manipulation, including tokenization and finding specific text segments.

groups.label: Configuration Management
groups.title: DSPy Configuration
groups.description: Handles global and context-specific settings for DSPy programs, ensuring thread-safe access and overrides.

groups.label: Data Preparation
groups.title: Background Data Preparation
groups.description: Utility for loading and formatting background passages associated with queries, typically for retrieval tasks.
